newsitem.title: USA: Gotham group cuts Bay Meadows stake.
newsitem.headline: Gotham group cuts Bay Meadows stake.

text.p: A group led by Gotham Partners L.P. said Tuesday it reduced its stake in Bay Meadows Operating Co/California Jockey Club to 6.23 percent or 359,109 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the New York-based investment group said it sold 5,753 shares of California Jockey, which trades as a pair with each share of Bay Meadows.
In addition, the group said it sold short 155,000 shares of California Jockey Club between November 7 and 11 at prices ranging from $34.33 to $34.94 a share.
It said the second quantity was sold "short against the box," which means it continues to hold the shares and has not delivered the shares involved in the transaction.
On October 31, Patriot American Hospitality Inc announced it had agreed to acquire Bay Meadows/California Jockey in a deal valued at $195 million.

Patriot is a Dallas-based real estrate investment trust. Bay Meadows operates the Bay Meadows horse racing track in San Francisco while California Jockey is a REIT that owns the race track land and other pieces of land nearby.
